love Gossoms End Surgery. Staff is so lovely and very approachable. They are super helpful, kind and have mutual interest in helping with health issues.
Myself and my child has never had any issues with anything. I had several interactions on the phone, face to face and online... And all are so real, humane, so kind and respectful and I would even say outgoing!!

If I'm unsure I ask, if I fill the form online- I don't have to double check-I know they monitor the system regularly. When we communicste I listen to them and they listen to me... Reception Staff, Doctors, Nurses, all of them.
If there is an appointment, I'll wait for it, if I have to find other working solution they will also advise me on my options. Nobody ignores me in there, nobody was ever unpleasant and to be totally honest this is the most supportive Surgery I have ever been to.

I had to change my old GP for Gossoms End, I really don't like changes this big. However, since singing up, in a short period of time I have had decent appointments, have sorted a lot of health issues, as well as other worries and got through assessments that I couldn't get for toffees at the previous surgery... That taught me a lot and has helped me achieve my health goals which in total improved my life and my child's life.

The negative reviews I have read here, really don't reflect the reality. It's the way you communicate and behave towards others that gives you that negative view on the world around you.
So I hope that everyone who wrote the low ratings, have had a long look in the mirror and asked themselves "have I done my best?", best to understand, best to communicate well, best to understand the issue, to be reasonable and to find a working solution ?? everyone can complain, but neither included what did they actually do to help it.
Mr Olivander would say that's "curious, very curious"... 😉.",null,[0,228]]]],[null,1754056721000000,1754056721000000,"7 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/5026059853475305548/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFTY0ZsVldUSlVXR042WTNreFpscFVhR3RhUkdoQ1RWZGFOVmd3UlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/5026059853475305548/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFTY0ZsVldUSlVXR042WTNreFpscFVhR3RhUkdoQ1RWZGFOVmd3UlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/5026059853475305548/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFTY0ZsVldUSlVXR042WTNreFpscFVhR3RhUkdoQ1RWZGFOVmd3UlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/5026059853475305548/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFTY0ZsVldUSlVXR042WTNreFpscFVhR3RhUkdoQ1RWZGFOVmd3UlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/5026059853475305548/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFTY0ZsVldUSlVXR042WTNreFpscFVhR3RhUkdoQ1RWZGFOVmd3UlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/5026059853475305548/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFTY0ZsVldUSlVXR042WTNreFpscFVhR3RhUkdoQ1RWZGFOVmd3UlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for the fantastic review.
